label: EU-eudpr-2018 Article 48

obligations.text: Authorisations by the European Data Protection Supervisor on the basis of Article 9(7) of Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 shall remain valid until amended, replaced or repealed, if necessary, by the European Data Protection Supervisor.
The Union institutions and bodies shall inform the European Data Protection Supervisor of the categories of cases in which this Article has been applied.
